title: Word Frequency Counter
prompt:
Implement word_counts, which counts how often each word appears in a text.

Rules:
- A word is a maximal run of ASCII alphanumeric characters; everything else is a separator.
- Words are case-insensitive: convert them to lowercase before counting.
- Return a HashMap<String, usize> from word to count.

Also implement top_word, which returns the most frequent word and its count. Break ties by choosing the alphabetically smallest word. Return None if there are no words.

Example:
  word_counts("Hello, hello world!") -> {"hello": 2, "world": 1}
  top_word("b a b a c") -> Some(("a".to_string(), 2))
